# What each query answers for a principal that is not the administrator.
#
# Written by go test -update. A line is a query that answered differently for
# the principal named in the section. An empty section means every query gave
# the administrator's answer, which is what a principal owning the objects
# ought to get.
#
# A section is <database>/<scene>/<principal>. The scene is the database the
# comparison ran in, because a contained user needs one of its own.

[cassandra/same/grantee]
privileges refused: RowData error: User dbmeta_grantee has no SELECT permission on <table system_auth.role_permissions> or any of its parents
role_grants refused: RowData error: User dbmeta_grantee has no SELECT permission on <table system_auth.role_members> or any of its parents
roles refused: RowData error: User dbmeta_grantee has no SELECT permission on <table system_auth.roles> or any of its parents
settings refused: RowData error: User dbmeta_grantee has no SELECT permission on <table system_views.settings> or any of its parents

[mariadb/same/grantee]
aggregates refused: Error 1142 (42000): SELECT command denied to user 'dbmeta_grantee'@'client' for table `mysql`.`proc`
column_stats refused: Error 1142 (42000): SELECT command denied to user 'dbmeta_grantee'@'client' for table `mysql`.`column_stats`
current_user the same rows with different values
foreign_servers refused: Error 1142 (42000): SELECT command denied to user 'dbmeta_grantee'@'client' for table `mysql`.`servers`
role_grants refused: Error 1142 (42000): SELECT command denied to user 'dbmeta_grantee'@'client' for table `mysql`.`roles_mapping`
roles refused: Error 1142 (42000): SELECT command denied to user 'dbmeta_grantee'@'client' for table `mysql`.`user`
user_mappings refused: Error 1142 (42000): SELECT command denied to user 'dbmeta_grantee'@'client' for table `mysql`.`servers`

[mysql/same/grantee]
current_user the same rows with different values
foreign_servers refused: Error 1142 (42000): SELECT command denied to user 'dbmeta_grantee'@'client' for table 'servers'
functions the same rows with different values
role_grants refused: Error 1142 (42000): SELECT command denied to user 'dbmeta_grantee'@'client' for table 'role_edges'
roles refused: Error 1142 (42000): SELECT command denied to user 'dbmeta_grantee'@'client' for table 'user'
user_mappings refused: Error 1142 (42000): SELECT command denied to user 'dbmeta_grantee'@'client' for table 'servers'

[oracle/same/local]
current_schema the same rows with different values
current_user the same rows with different values

[postgres/same/grantee]
current_user the same rows with different values
settings fewer rows than the administrator
tablespaces refused: ERROR: permission denied for tablespace pg_global (SQLSTATE 42501)

[postgres/same/owner]
current_user the same rows with different values
settings fewer rows than the administrator
tablespaces refused: ERROR: permission denied for tablespace pg_global (SQLSTATE 42501)

[sqlserver/contained/contained]
current_user the same rows with different values

[sqlserver/same/login]
current_user the same rows with different values
roles fewer rows than the administrator
